modelLimits: The episode adopts the classic puzzle's continuation-comparison voting convention and common knowledge of the ordered preferences and the same future reasoning.
Complete rationality alone should not be advertised as an unconditional uniqueness theorem for all simultaneous-voting equilibria; non-pivotal voting refinements are beyond this instructional model.
No external transfers, binding coalitions, promises or negotiations are part of the episode model; this is an explicit scope limit, not an empirical assertion.
Every accepted proposal uses100 indivisible coins; at-least-half and strict-majority cases are separate.
The reading log contains no local program execution, source-freeze, TTS, media review, or deployment-success claim.
